observations: Photo 0 shows a console with a camouflage/olive patterned shell, no visible Sony or PlayStation logo, no model number or serial plate readable.
Two sealed boxes labeled 'X6 Wireless Controller FOR Switch/PS4/PS3/PC/iOS/Android' sit on top of the console — these are third-party controllers, not official Sony DualShock units.
A power cable with a UK three-pin plug and what appears to be a black cable (possibly HDMI or USB) are coiled on the console.
Background shows a shop/glass cabinet reflection; no power-on test, no UI screen, no disc tray shot.
No close-up of any label, port layout, or engraving that would confirm the console's make or model.

claims.evidence: No Sony logo, PlayStation branding, or model number visible anywhere in photo 0; the shell is covered in a camo skin that obscures any identifying marks.
No power-on, boot screen, or gameplay clip shown; purely a static photo of the unit and accessories.

risks.risk: Console may not be a genuine Sony PS4 (camo skin could be hiding a different or modified unit, or a fake/clone).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rear/underside with Sony model number sticker (e.g., CUH-21xx) and the PlayStation logo on the top panel, skin removed or lifted.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified/generic console, not as a confirmed Sony PS4 Slim

risks.risk: Unit may not power on, read discs, or boot to the dashboard (no functional test shown).
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on, showing the PS4 home screen and a disc or digital game loading.

risks.risk: Internal storage condition/capacity unknown (HDD could be failing or swapped to a smaller drive).
risks.proof: Screenshot of System Storage settings showing capacity and health, or Settings > System Information.
risks.if_unproven: priced as base/unknown storage, no premium for capacity

risks.risk: Included controllers are third-party 'X6' pads, not original Sony DualShock, which affects bundle value.
risks.proof: Photo of an official Sony DualShock controller if one is actually included; otherwise treat as third-party accessory only.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-only with generic third-party controllers, not original DualShock

risks.risk: Cables shown may not include original Sony HDMI/power cables (generic replacements could affect completeness value).
risks.proof: Close-up of cable ends/labels showing Sony branding.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the Sony/PlayStation logo and model number plate on the console (skin removed or lifted).
Video of the console powering on and loading the dashboard or a game.
Screenshot of System Storage to confirm hard drive health and capacity.
Photo showing whether an original Sony DualShock controller is included, separate from the third-party X6 pads.
response.reason: The single photo never shows a Sony logo, PlayStation branding, or model number — the unit is fully covered by a camo skin — so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored to 'PS4 Slim' versus an unknown or cloned console; identity-confirming proof is needed before pricing.
